name: kyberna DataCenter Balzers
notes: kyberna AG company page confirms Inbetriebnahme (commissioning) of its own data center in Liechtenstein in 2011 (A operator page); 2011 press reported the ceremonial opening (B); directory listings place the facility at Fabrikstrasse 4, 9496 Balzers (C). Capacity not disclosed. Balzers Bauverwaltung permit confirmation pending.

name: vestra ICT Data Center Eschen
notes: vestra ICT official site states 'Unsere Rechenzentren in Eschen und Vaduz' (A operator-stated existence of Eschen+Vaduz DCs); Data Center Map directory seed places the Eschen site at Hub 37 (C); RIPE member record gives vestra address Landstrasse 107, 9490 Vaduz (A entity address). Exact Eschen address and specs need commune/AHR permit confirmation.

name: SupraNet Eschen Data Center
notes: SupraNet official page states housing products run from two modern data centers in Eschen and Schaan (A operator-stated); directory seed places the Eschen site at Wirtschaftspark 65 (C). Operator describes ~200 m2 facility with redundant power/UPS/diesel and redundant fiber; exact active address and permit status pending Eschen Bauverwaltung confirmation.

name: LKW Kollokation TZ Eschen (Hub 37)
notes: Official LKW Kollokation Standortliste (A, per country methodology verified ledger) lists LKW network-access colocation sites incl. Eschen Hub 37; Rheintal IX lists a live physical location at Telefonzentrale Eschen, Liechtensteinische Kraftwerke, Hub 37 (B). Classified as telecom/access-network colocation point, not automatically a commercial datacenter; capacity not disclosed.

name: Acronis Liechtenstein Cloud Data Center (micro RZ)
notes: Trade/local press (Netzwoche, liechtenstein.li, Moneycab) reported Acronis opened a new (micro) data center in Eschen in late December 2020, the 111th Acronis cloud datacenter, providing a local cloud location for MSPs and customer data sovereignty in Liechtenstein. Capacity not disclosed; described as micro data center.

name: LLV Rechenzentrum Eschen (Landesverwaltung / Amt fuer Informatik)
notes: Official government media release (regierung.li, 2025-08-21) describes the government's visit to the LLV Rechenzentrum in Eschen; facility has redundant power, redundant cooling and aerosol fire suppression (A official). State administration data center serving Landesverwaltung; capacity not disclosed.

name: rechenzentrum.li / Alpensoft ONLINE Mauren (historical lead)
notes: Weak historical lead only: rechenzentrum.li (Schellenbergerstr. 39, 9493 Mauren) currently shows the site as disabled/missing; a business directory describes Alpensoft ONLINE at the same address with hosting/server-housing keywords. Operational status and facility scale unverified; no commune/AHR/LKW permit evidence found in sweep.

name: SpeedCom Ruggell Data Center
notes: lie:zeit (2017) lists SpeedCom AG datacenter locations as Schaan and Ruggell (B press); SpeedCom official materials state two independent data centers in Liechtenstein with georedundancy and ISO 27001:2022 certification (A operator-stated); directory seed places the Ruggell site at Industriering 14 (C). Capacity not disclosed.

name: SpeedCom Schaan Data Center (ex-Newsnet)
notes: SpeedCom official materials state it operates two independent data centers in Liechtenstein (A); lie:zeit (2017) and directories place the main Schaan facility at Im alten Riet 153 (B/C), historically Newsnet AG which SpeedCom acquired in Feb 2016; RIPE member record confirms Newsnet AG LI entity (A). Facility has redundant UPS, diesel and high-availability cooling per operator/directory. Capacity not disclosed.

name: SupraNet Schaan Data Center
notes: SupraNet official page confirms high-security data centers in Schaan and Eschen (A operator-stated); directory seeds place the Schaan site at Im alten Riet 121 (C); SCHAEFER IT Systems vendor case study documents SupraNet's modernization of its data center white space (B). Capacity not disclosed; exact active site and permits pending Schaan Bauverwaltung confirmation.

name: vestra ICT Data Center Vaduz
notes: vestra ICT official site states its data centers are in Eschen and Vaduz with 100% data residency in Liechtenstein (A operator-stated); RIPE member record gives company address Landstrasse 107, 9490 Vaduz (A entity address); Data Center Map lists two vestra ICT facilities (C). Whether the Vaduz DC sits at Landstrasse 107 requires Vaduz Bauverwaltung/permit confirmation.

name: ICT-Center Vaduz
notes: Directory-led colocation/cloud facility of ICT-Center AG at Schwefelstrasse 5A, 9490 Vaduz; Inflect claims 1.0 MW power capacity (C, unverified); Mergr confirms company address Schwefelstrasse 5a Vaduz (C). No operator/register/permit source found yet; do not treat directory MW as verified. Pending Handelsregister/Vaduz permit check.
